game_intent.json.original_prompt: Create a dark top-down dungeon adventure where I explore ancient ruins, fight monsters, collect a key, activate a magical switch, and unlock the final chamber containing a treasure.

quests.text: Speak with Eldrin the hermit to learn of the dungeon's perils.
Defeat the Shadow Fiend guarding the outer ruins.
Collect the Ancient Key from the ruins floor.
Explore the Sanctuary Gate to enter the Inner Sanctuary.
Activate the Runed Switch in the inner chamber.
Unlock the Vault Door using the key and activated switch.
Claim the Golden Chalice from the final chamber.

model_design.json.title: Depths of the Ancient Ruins
model_design.json.premise: Venture into dark, forgotten ruins, defeat lurking monsters, secure the dungeon key, activate the seal, and unlock the final chamber for the hidden treasure.

greeting: Beware the shadows in these ruins, traveler.
Seek the key and activate the switch if you wish to proceed.
active: Have you found the dungeon key yet?
completed: You have proven your valor. The inner sanctum awaits.
